name: 2026-10-14-decodeC-cal-gh200
design: design-decode DESIGN.md (2026-10-14, design only, read-only against 80514a6) and the owner's decisions of 2026-10-14: DD1 NATIVE alone certifies, SHARED's declaration arm (DECL) an optional lever on CAL models; DD2 vLLM's naive path (T 1 to 3) in scope; DD3 a summary-statistics-only extraction at B 1 to 128, or the design's fallback (rental 5's fitted shapes extrapolated) when the raw traces are unavailable, registered; DD4 the multi-call CUDA graph (GRR) is the primary timer, a one-call graph (GR1) the control; DD5 provisional bars rms <= 3%, worst <= 8%, |mean| <= 1.5%; DD6 decode runs after the tile stage (built now, rented after tile rental B)
tool: scorer scripts/scoring/decode/score_cal.py (dcommon: fit_and_select, g3d, gd2_band, gd3, stop_rule); pages scripts/decode_synth.py; model scripts/r3_timing_model_v4d.py
what: the decode stage's CAL rental on OLMoE-1B-7B and Mixtral-8x7B: v4d's three CAL constants and its rho selection, the instruments' agreement (GD2, GD3), G3-D, the DECL lever, the counter pages, the replicate (sigma_page and the blind bars), and the STOP rule for the blind rental
drop_order: last first: rep, decl, ncu, e240; every main and ctl unit is nodrop

census.rule: the tile stage's tile_census.py, compile only; its occupancy replaces the shared-memory rule in v4d (tcommon.use_census); a path mismatch is a STOP

instruments.GRR: one CUDA graph of `calls` calls, call j on copy j mod R, no flush; per call = replay / calls (launch_floor.graph_call, launch_floor.mirror_time_cell at duty 0.25, lock 1710)
instruments.GR1: a one-call graph, the 240 MiB flush outside it
instruments.E240: the eager call, the 240 MiB flush

model.name: v4d (scripts/r3_timing_model_v4d.py) over v4 and the pinned v3 machinery
model.formula: T = T0_GR + s_path + sum_g [gemm_g + dead_g] + B_other / bw
model.fit: v4d.fit_constants: weighted least squares on the relative error over the valid NATIVE cells of the two CAL main pages (the replicate excluded), cells the wgmma tile cannot price excluded

rho_forms.fixed: 11.48 GB/s per resident CTA (v3's CORES rho)
rho_forms.scaled: x the tile's weight bytes in flight per CTA over R3's (16x64x128 s4: 2.0)

model.rho_selection: the lower CAL rms on sub-wave cells; fixed unless scaled's rms is lower by 0.1 percentage points of rms (ABSOLUTE, 0.001)
model.fill: FILL0: padded and masked rows cost 0 (G3-D fill tests it)
model.tile_stage: v4's finalised Params (tileA/finalise.selections), census occupancy per decode tile; REQUIRED: score_cal.py refuses without --tile-scores
model.struck_rivals: L2-survival and FILL-r, struck before any page (build-decode review 5)

gates.V-BIN: bincount(ids) == counts, k distinct experts per token (feasible, realize_counts); a failure refuses the cell
gates.V-ALIGN: the spy's readback of one eager call (sorted ids None iff naive; num_tokens_post_padded; sentinel count P; expert_ids[:L] ascending; sorted length the capped buffer; the launch grid fused_moe_grid's; USE_TD False) equals r3_decode.expected_readback; a mismatch refuses the cell; any refused CAL cell is a STOP
gates.GD5: the config the kernel received is tile_resolve.default_config(T, E), vLLM finds no tuned file and no override
gates.GD4: every captured call's output equals the eager output bit for bit; a failure VOIDS the page. It covers the CHECK-PHASE capture only: each timed repeat recaptures the same calls on the same tensors and is not compared again
gates.COPIES: (GRR) calls 0..R-1 are each spied in the check phase and must read R distinct w1 copies (r3_decode.check_copies); a failure refuses the cell. At R = 1 the call is cold by volume only (see coldness)
gates.GD1: GPU per replay >= 3 x the host enqueue per replay (launch_floor's host probe, before and after); a failing cell is excluded (G2)
gates.GD2: GR1 - GRR per call on matched cells; the CAL band [p05 - 1 us, p95 + 1 us] is frozen into the blind registration; a STOP when CAL's median is outside [-1, 10] us, the band is wider than 8 us, or the band leaves [-2, 11] us; a blind GR1 page with over 20% of its cells outside the band VOIDS that model's GRR page
gates.GD3: E240 - GR1 in [0, 10] us on cells GPU-bound eager (C + F240 > 1.25 H): DESCRIPTIVE
gates.G1: rental 7's r7-median-run3 rebuilt from cells.csv (6 of 9 clean; the 10% non-clean cap); a FAIL puts the page out (NOT SCORED)
gates.G2: GD1, and the duty timer's host flag
gates.G5: the page's decode-page sha256 and every row's counts sha256 are the registered ones
gates.V-SRC: the VM's installed fused_moe.py and moe_align_block_size.py are v0.27.1's bytes (moe/instrumented/UPSTREAM_DECODE.json); else the page is refused before any cell

olmoe-1b-7b.how: COLD BY ROTATION: call j reads copy j mod 3 (COPIES checks 3 distinct addresses); 288 MiB between two reads of one copy

mixtral-8x7b.how: COLD BY VOLUME ONLY: R = 1, every call reads copy 0; between two reads of a slab the call streams at least A_min x W_e = 672 MiB, 11x the L2

E1-CAL-IN-SAMPLE.label: IN-SAMPLE (the CAL constants are fitted on these cells)
E1-CAL-IN-SAMPLE.rule: e_dec on every valid NATIVE main-page cell at the selected rho, against the provisional bars; a FAIL is a STOP

tests.G3-D shuffle: UNIFORM counts with rows shuffled (U-T) against unshuffled (US-T), T 8, 32, 128
tests.G3-D label: the same count multiset on another active set: MIN-T (experts 0..k-1) against L-T-A<k>, T 4, 16, 64
tests.G3-D fill (FILL0, a model test): BALANCED cells of one A at two T in one tile band
tests.G3-D margin: max(0.3 us, 0.36% x the median reference time); TOST at 90%, clusters (model, T)
tests.rep: OLMoE's main page again: sigma_page = rms(rep / main - 1) / sqrt 2 over valid NATIVE pairs; the blind bars are tightened from it (dcommon.tighten), never loosened
tests.DECL (DESCRIPTIVE): DECL - NATIVE per BALANCED cell at T >= BM against v4d's dead-CTA difference
tests.BYTES-D (DESCRIPTIVE): the counter pages' dram__bytes_read per GEMM against v4d's read bytes

stop_rule: STOP (the blind rental does not run) when any: a nodrop CAL unit not counted (missing, NOT SCORED, G1 FAIL or GD4 VOID); the fit NOT FITTED under both rho forms; the tile stage's selections missing or any valid CAL NATIVE cell NOT PRICED; E1-CAL-IN-SAMPLE fails the provisional bars; G3-D shuffle or label not EQUIVALENT; any CAL cell refused by V-ALIGN, GD5 or COPIES; GD2 FAIL (median outside [-1, 10] us, band over 8 us wide or leaving [-2, 11] us). Else GO. Refused and failed cells are taken out of G1's non-clean share before it is counted (dcommon.drop_dead_cells), so a refusal cannot fail the page

trace_statistics.primary: NOT RUN: rental 5's three routing logs are gone (scratchpad reanalysis/data empty on 2026-10-14, no copy under moe-kernels-work); the design's fallback is used and registered (owner decision DD3)
trace_statistics.fallback: rental 5's fitted DW shapes (synth_fit.json, fitted at B >= 256) EXTRAPOLATED to B 1 to 128 (coverage_stats.json, DW-T cells)
trace_statistics.finding: the DW shapes cut coverage by at most about 9 points against uniform (OLMoE B 16 0.80 against 0.89); the ladder, not the trace draws, is the lever

upstream.design_check: every decode rule of design-decode DESIGN.md sections 1 and 5 agrees with these lines: naive iff T k 4 <= E; max_num_tokens_padded = numel + E (BM - 1), capped at numel BM when numel < E; EM cut when A rows < BM; grid cdiv(EM, BM) x cdiv(N, BN); dead CTAs past num_tokens_post_padded; live tiles sum ceil(c_e / BM), expert_ids ascending; sentinel numel; small-batch at numel < 1024 and E <= 64; default tiles 16x64x128 w4 s4 (T <= 32), 32x64x128 w4 s3 (33..64), 32x128x64 w4 s3 (65..96), 64x128x64 w4 s3 (97..128), GROUP_SIZE_M 1. The fused_moe.py sha256 equals moe/instrumented/UPSTREAM.json's file_sha256 (design-r4's copy). One addition the design did not name: invoke_fused_moe_triton_kernel's USE_TD flag (resolve_moe_use_td, an environment switch); the spy records it and V-ALIGN requires it False

nominal: DESIGN-NOMINAL: v4d at the tile stage's nominal wgmma constants (c_128 900, F_wg 520 / 979) and T0_GR 25 us, s 0; for scale, levers and power only

rental.rule: units plus prelude 3 and calibrate 2 (and the CAL census 6), x 1/0.84 (rentals 4 to 7) plus 15 min boot and setup

scorer_ambiguities.1 'each relative error floored at 1 us': read as: an absolute error at or under 1 us counts as 0; otherwise e = (pred - meas) / meas (v4d.rel_err)
scorer_ambiguities.2 T0_GR + s_path: s_small_GR is folded into T0_GR: every cell has exactly one path, so the three CAL constants are T0_GR (the small-batch constant), s_naive_GR and s_block_GR (offsets); block-scan occurs on OLMoE at T 128 in CAL, so s_block_GR is fitted, not assumed
scorer_ambiguities.3 the wgmma decode tile (T 97..128, 64x1: v4d prices it with the tile stage's finalised v4 constants (c_128, F_wg, accounting, F form, census occupancy; scripts/scoring/tileA/finalise.selections). With none, those cells are NOT PRICED and out of E1-DEC and the fit
scorer_ambiguities.4 the hot expert's second tile: priced at a full slab re-read (sigma 1). The L2-survival rival and the FILL-r rival are STRUCK before any page (build-decode review 5): neither is priced; G3-D fill is FILL0's test and MINCOVER past BM shows the second tile's cost as a residual
scorer_ambiguities.5 naive repeats: vLLM launches the naive path token-major (expert_ids = topk_ids.view(-1)); v4d lists the rows expert-ascending, which leaves the read total and the throughput sum unchanged and moves only the window means and the tail set. A repeated expert's slab is fetched once (the later CTA in launch order hits L2); NAIVE-NODEDUP is the rival
scorer_ambiguities.6 G3-D clusters: (model, T) for shuffle and label, (model, tile band) for fill; d in microseconds net of v4d's own predicted difference
scorer_ambiguities.7 GD2's void: a blind GR1 page outside the band voids the model's GRR page (the instruments disagree on that model, so the primary cannot be trusted there)
scorer_ambiguities.8 GRR rotation: R = ceil(240 MiB / (A_min W_e)) copies per page, A_min the page's least coverage; calls per graph the least multiple of R at or over 8
scorer_ambiguities.9 CERTIFIED: a blind model is CERTIFIED when its own E1-DEC bar holds and the pooled bar holds
scorer_ambiguities.10 the rho margin: ABSOLUTE: scaled is selected only when its sub-wave rms is lower than fixed's by at least 0.001, i.e. 0.1 percentage points of rms (not 0.1% of fixed's rms)
scorer_ambiguities.11 an unfitted offset: never 0: a path with no valid CAL row has no offset, its cells are NOT PRICED, and any NOT PRICED CAL cell is a STOP
scorer_ambiguities.12 NOT PRICED is never silent: the CAL scorer REFUSES without --tile-scores (the tile stage's selections; every CAL main page holds T 97..128 cells), STOPs on any NOT PRICED CAL cell, and the blind scorer lists NOT PRICED cells per model
scorer_ambiguities.13 the pooled blind bar: computed over the models that survive (not voided by GD2 or G3-D, with at least one valid priced cell); the score names them (pooled_over)
scorer_ambiguities.14 blind G3-D INCONCLUSIVE: a TOST that is NOT EQUIVALENT (the interval leaves the margin, whether by a shift or by width) voids the model's cells; NOT SCORED (under 2 clusters) voids nothing
scorer_ambiguities.15 the 1 us floor: kept as a STEP and stated: |pred - meas| <= 1 us counts 0, above it the full relative error counts (at a 12 us cell an 8% error, 0.96 us, counts 0; 9%, 1.08 us, counts 9%)
scorer_ambiguities.16 sub-wave: a cell is sub-wave when some GEMM's live CTAs are under SMs x its occupancy, the occupancy the census's (tile rental A's census score) where it exists, else the shared-memory rule: the rho selection's cell set moves with the census

seen_data: every published page (rentals 1 to 7) is SEEN
rental 6's CAL fit (c, bw, eager T0)
rental 2's host enqueue 0.33 to 0.36 ms per R3 call (GD1's motivation)
